verifiedEvidence: sharp v0.34.5 package.json pins @img/sharp-libvips-win32-x64 to 1.2.4 as a development dependency.
sharp v0.34.5 npm/from-local-build.js copies Apache-2.0 LICENSE and appends the native package third-party licensing table to the Windows package README.md.
sharp-libvips v1.2.4 build/win.sh downloads vips-dev-w64-web-8.17.3-static.zip from libvips/build-win64-mxe.
The downloaded ZIP SHA-256 matches the digest published by the GitHub release API.
The archive's bin/libvips-42.dll SHA-256 matches the installed node_modules/@img/sharp-win32-x64/lib/libvips-42.dll byte-for-byte.
The archive's versions.json has the same component names and versions as the installed sharp Windows package manifest.
The verified official Windows ZIP contains one top-level LICENSE file (LGPL 2.1). No complete per-component license collection was found in this ZIP.

The installed package README.md states that LGPLv3 usage invokes the any-later-version clause of LGPLv2 or LGPLv2.1; LGPL 3 and its incorporated GPL 3 terms are supplied from GNU's canonical text URLs.
